prep.what: Finish the in-progress per-tenant DEK envelope encryption layer. Each tenant's sensitive data is encrypted by a unique Data Encryption Key (DEK); the DEK itself is wrapped by a master Key Encryption Key (KEK) before storage, creating a two-layer envelope. Completing this unlocks cryptographic tenant isolation before Phase 1 begins.
understand: What's already done in the in_progress state — find the KeyManager or encryption service stub and read what exists
DEK envelope pattern: AES-256 DEK per tenant, encrypted with KEK (env secret or KMS), stored in tenant_keys table; decrypt path reverses the wrapping
Which Eloquent models and fields need DEK-encrypted attributes — agency data, PII, outreach content
approach: Read existing encryption code to find the in_progress seam — don't rewrite what's already done
Complete KeyManager: generateDEK(), encryptWithKEK(dek), decryptWithKEK(encryptedDek)
Apply DEK via EncryptsAttributes trait or cast on sensitive model fields
Add tenant_keys migration if not already present (tenant_id, encrypted_dek, created_at, key_version)
Isolation test: encrypt a value with tenant A's DEK, attempt decrypt with tenant B's — must fail

prep.what: Build the state machine that gates outbound influencer outreach behind an explicit approval step. Drafted messages enter pending_outbound — a human review queue — before being queued for delivery. Transitions: draft → pending_outbound → approved → sent | rejected → draft (editable again).
understand: The existing outbound message model and its current status/state fields — what's already in place from the in_progress state
Who approves (agency user role) and what UI they use to see the pending queue
How the downstream Inngest send job is triggered on approval
approach: Add state enum (draft, pending_outbound, approved, rejected, sent) to the message model if not present
Implement guarded transition methods: submitForApproval(), approve(), reject(reason), markSent()
Build an ApprovalQueue resource/controller action filtered to pending_outbound for the reviewer role
On approve(): transition state and enqueue the Inngest send job
On reject(): store reason, transition back to draft so the copy can be revised and resubmitted

prep.what: Complete the assemblies-per-room engine: given room geometry, produce per-material quantity outputs — gallons of paint, sheets of drywall, square feet of flooring — per room and as project totals. Coverage formulas: paint ~350 sqft/gal gross → two-coat effective ~175 sqft/gal; drywall 32 sqft per 4×8 sheet; flooring: raw sqft + 10% waste factor
Output shape expected by the estimator export — per-room breakdown + project totals
approach: Read the existing AssemblyEngine or quantity calculator to find what's already done in the in_progress state

Drive calculators from room geometry: wall area = perimeter × height − door/window openings; ceiling = floor area
Aggregate results: per-room material breakdown + project-level totals object
Validate with a known room: 10×12 bedroom, 8ft ceiling → verify expected gallons, sheets, flooring sqft
